title.value: A portrait of the different configurations between digitally-enabled innovations and climate governance
title.justification: The title focuses on the relationship between digital innovations and climate governance, indicating the central theme of the paper.
title.quote: A portrait of the different configurations between digitally-enabled innovations and climate governance

extractions.description: The paper examines how digital technologies are being used to support climate governance. It analyzes various strategies employed by digitally-enabled initiatives to transform and influence climate governance, proposing a framework to categorize these strategies and highlighting their potential to re-imagine climate governance systems.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is exploring how digitally-enabled innovations can transform climate governance to address climate change, a core sustainable development issue.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Could the digital age be leveraged to transform the way we govern climate mitigation?

primary_category.justification: The paper's focus on digital technologies influencing climate governance aligns with climate change mitigation efforts through various digital strategies to reduce greenhouse gases and enhance sustainability.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The mention of environmental commodity markets and data for investment decisions corresponds to climate finance.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Optimization of existing strategy: Initiatives that increase the efficiency or accuracy of existing strategies.

applications.value: Use of AI and big data for improving efficiency and accuracy in climate strategies
applications.justification: The paper extensively discusses the role of AI and big data in enhancing decision-making and data mobilization for climate governance, a direct application in climate change mitigation.
applications.quote: By using statistical models and algorithms to analyse data, including large datasets such as big data, machine learning helps to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in various ways.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories adequately describe the main focus of the paper on digitally-enabled climate governance and its role in climate change mitigation.
new_primary_category.quote: There is a proliferation of climate action leveraging digital technologies that have emerged over the past decade.
